headerDisplay: Reads the house controllers off the shared MQTT broker. Each board publishes a retained state document, so accessories appear as soon as the bridge subscribes - nothing is polled.

host.title: Host
host.description: hc-data, the broker the controllers already publish to.

username.title: Username
username.description: A read-only account. It must not be a device account: those are write-only and see nothing.

exposeHeatingDeltas.title: Expose supply/return differences
exposeHeatingDeltas.description: Adds the differences the heating firmware computes as extra temperature sensors. HomeKit has no service for a difference, so 8 K shows as 8 °C - useful for automations, wrong as a unit.

exposeGateCameraHealth.title: Expose gate camera health
exposeGateCameraHealth.description: The gate reports no position, so it has no door accessory. This adds a contact sensor for whether its camera is alive.

include.title: Only expose these
include.description: Accessory names such as "Outdoor", or full ids such as "heating:aabbcc000001:28ff000000000001" when two boards use the same label. Leave empty to expose everything. Anything already in Apple Home and not on this list is removed on the next restart.

exclude.title: Expose everything except these
exclude.description: Ignored when the include list is not empty.

staleAfterSeconds.title: Treat a device as unreachable after (s)
staleAfterSeconds.description: A board that stops refreshing its state document reports no response, rather than showing a frozen reading.
